payload.claim: No test exercises the `t.spec_id = ?` term of `previous_cut_orphan`'s query. Every witness for the retry cap (`test_a_second_cut_at_one_spec_sha_settles_the_spec`, `test_a_task_orphaned_by_anything_but_a_cut_leaves_the_retry`, and the criterion-2 witness) drives every task through `_spec()`'s default `spec_id="SY-1"`, varying only `spec_sha`. Replacing the source condition `AND t.spec_id = ?` with an always-true check on the same bound parameter (e.g. `AND ? IS NOT NULL`) leaves every test in the diff green, even though the acceptance criteria and the docstring both name spec id as part of the scoping key (repo, spec id, spec_sha) — a regression that drops the spec_id filter would only surface if two different specs in the same repo ever shared a `spec_sha`, which no test here can distinguish from a correct implementation.
